sources.title: On almost commuting matrices with respect to the normalized Hilbert--Schmidt norm
sources.use: Corollary 1.4: finite N-tuples admit commuting approximants with squared normalized-HS error C(N) max_commutator^(2/3^(N-1)); source theorem is not a CP-map lifting result.

sources.title: Optimal state estimation for d-dimensional quantum systems
sources.use: Equation (16): optimal Haar-mean pure-state estimation fidelity from n identical d-dimensional copies is (n+1)/(n+d), used in N61 ladder lower bound.
Equations (13)-(14) give supplied corrected-broadcaster commutator estimate; equation (27) gives whole-CP-range near-commutativity and exact open map-lifting gate.
